cues.text: Welcome to the matter lab. You will heat ice, test substances and pour liquids to find out how matter behaves. Predict first, then watch what really happens.
Bench one: states and changes. A beaker sits on a hot plate, on top of a weighing scale. Predict first, then heat it and watch.
Now the physical and chemical bench. You have a hammer, a magnet, a bulb circuit, a burner and a beaker of water. Predict each result before you test.
Welcome to the density bench. Weigh and measure the liquids, see how they behave together, and find out why some things float.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
That is every question on every bench. Open your summary to see how your predictions and explanations went.
